title: ctenitis tabacifera
intro: Ctenitis tabacifera, commonly known as the tobacco fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ctenitis tabacifera include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential remedy for infections, wounds, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
